name: Warmage (CR 7)
body:
HUMAN WARMAGE
CR 7

The tall woman adjusts her armor, then begins to incant magic words as she prepares for battle.

XP 3,200
Human warmage 8
LG humanoid (human)
Init +0; Senses Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 17; touch 10, flat-footed 17 (+6 armor, +1 shield)
hp 48 (8d8+8)
Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk morningstar +6 (1d8+1)
Special Attacks shift (20 ft., 7/day)
Warmage Spells Prepared (CL 8th; concentration +18)

4th–dimensional anchor, greater lightning bolt x2 (DC 20)*, wall of fire (DC 20)
3rd–dispel magic, fireball (DC 19), greater shocking grasp*, lesser cone of cold (DC 19)*
2nd-lesser storming grasp*, ray of sunlight*, resist energy, scorching ray
1st–burning hands (DC 17), deflection*, mage’s persistent blade*, magic missile, stunning barrier (DC 15)
Cantrips-fire bolt**, lesser shocking grasp*, light, resistance

Spell-like Abilities (CL 8th; concentration +18)

At will electric bolt (1d4/highest level electric spell, DC of highest spell)
7/day force missile (1d4+4)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 10, Con 12, Int 18, Wis 10, Cha 12
Base Atk +4; CMB +5; CMD 15
Feats Combat Castingb, Disrupt Spellcasting*, Electric Bolt*, Greater Spell Focus (evocation)B, Spell Focus (evocation), Spell Penetration, Sudden Empower B
Skills Craft (alchemy) +11, Heal +7, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (engineering) +13, Knowledge (geography) +11, Knowledge (history) +13, Profession (soldier) +7, Spellcraft +15
Languages Common, Draconic, Giant, a regional language salient to the campaign
SQ arcane strategy (force missile, resistance, shift, spell precision), armored mage, focused mind +2, sudden empower
Combat Gear 4 potions of cure light wounds, 2 potions of cure moderate wounds, potion of invisibility, wand of magic missile (50 charges), masterwork morningstar, masterwork dagger, mithral breastplate, light mithral shield, spellbook (0th – dancing lights, fire bolt, flare, lesser shocking grasp*, light, ray of frost, resistance, spark; 1st – burning hands, deflection*, ear-piercing scream, lesser fireburst*, mage’s persistent blade*, magic missile, protection from evil, shield, stunning barrier; 2nd – lesser storming grasp*, ray of sunlight*, resist energy, scorching ray; 3rd – dispel magic, fireball, greater shocking grasp*, lesser cone of cold*; 4th – dimensional anchor, greater lightning bolt*, shout, wall of fire), 122 gp
